affinity.notes: Product review finds the Earth affinity insufficiently integrated into the Death Knight itself. The revision must make mineral weight, sediment layering, and a readable load-bearing fault part of the armor construction without burying the undead identity.

anatomy.notes: The complete humanoid biped and armor load paths remain coherent.

archetype.notes: Sword guard, pennant, armor, and posture preserve the formation-commander duty.

counterplay.notes: The Earth load fault needs a clearer localized break point after committed movement.

finish.notes: The cinematic dark-fantasy finish is accepted.

framing.notes: The complete subject, weapon, pennant, and extremities remain in frame.

identity.notes: The skull-masked armored formation commander remains recognizably a Death Knight.

tier.notes: The candidate remains a bridge-only commander without claiming a canonical T1-T5 form.
